description: This file defines the Time class and related classes for handling date and time operations, including conversions, formatting, and parsing in various formats. It includes platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems, and provides constants and methods for time calculations, Julian date conversions, and epoch handling.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class representing date and time, with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions across different formats and platforms.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a Time object stored in local time, providing conversions and operations relative to local time.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object into a string representation, defaulting to RFC1123 format.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to the Time object.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts a specified number of milliseconds from the Time object.

methods.name: ToUTC
methods.description: Converts the Time object to Coordinated Universal Time.
